about: Presentation text for build menu hover descriptions. Units are keyed by the unit type key in data/unit_faction_stats.json; structures by structure type (0 FORWARD_OUTPOST, 1 RADAR_MAST, 2 AIRFIELD, 3 FLOODLIGHT). Rules stay native; this text describes them.

units.ELITE_MAIN_BATTLE_TANK: Main battle tank and the toughest Elite ground unit. Engages ground targets only, out to 115 m; it cannot fire at aircraft.
units.ELITE_LONG_RANGE_ARTILLERY: Long-range artillery. Engages ground targets only, out to 195 m, the longest reach of any Elite ground unit, but less armour than the tank.
units.ELITE_ANTI_AIR: Mobile anti-air vehicle. Engages aircraft only, out to 100 m; it cannot fire at ground units.
units.MASS_SWARM_TANK: Light, cheap tank meant to be fielded in numbers. Engages ground targets only, out to 90 m.
units.MASS_ASSAULT_VEHICLE: Assault vehicle. Engages ground targets only, out to 105 m. Paradrop capable: it can drop by parachute onto ground you can see, with no airfield.
units.MASS_ANTI_AIR: Mobile anti-air vehicle. Engages aircraft only, out to 95 m; it cannot fire at ground units.
units.INDUSTRIAL_MBT: Main battle tank. Engages ground targets only, out to 100 m; it cannot fire at aircraft.
units.INDUSTRIAL_MISSILE_PLATFORM: Missile platform. Engages ground targets only, out to 170 m; it cannot fire at aircraft.
units.INDUSTRIAL_ENGINEERING: Construction unit that builds structures and earthworks. Lightly armed: engages ground targets only, out to 50 m.
units.ELITE_T1_FIGHTER: Multirole fighter. Engages both ground and air targets, out to 120 m. Needs a friendly airfield: it is ferried in and lands on the runway.
units.ELITE_T1_VTOL: Vertical take-off strike aircraft. Engages both ground and air targets, out to 80 m. Needs no runway.
units.ELITE_SCOUT_CAR: Fast scout car with 650 m of sight. Engages ground targets only, out to 60 m. Paradrop capable: it can drop by parachute onto ground you can see, with no airfield.
units.ELITE_RECON_PLANE: Unarmed reconnaissance aircraft with 1,600 m of sight. Plot its flight on the map: it flies in from off the map, watches the area for 45 s, then leaves. Needs no airfield.
units.MASS_SCOUT_BIKE: Fast scout bike with 550 m of sight. Engages ground targets only, out to 60 m. Paradrop capable: it can drop by parachute onto ground you can see, with no airfield.
units.MASS_RECON_PLANE: Unarmed reconnaissance aircraft with 1,400 m of sight. Plot its flight on the map: it flies in from off the map, watches the area for 45 s, then leaves. Needs no airfield.
units.ELITE_PATROL_BOAT: Naval patrol boat. Operates on water. Engages ground targets only, out to 90 m; it cannot fire at aircraft.

structures.FORWARD_OUTPOST: Forward observation post. Gives 400 m of sight from a 20 m vantage point. It has no weapons.
structures.RADAR_MAST: Tall sensor mast. Gives 3,000 m of sight from 40 m up, seeing over rises that hide ground units. It has no weapons.
structures.AIRFIELD: Runway, hangar and tower on a 250 x 750 m site. Forces ordered from Strategic Command land beside it, fuel shipments fly in to it, and runway aircraft need it. Gives 500 m of sight.
structures.FLOODLIGHT: Lights the ground within 360 m by day and night, and gives 300 m of sight. It has no weapons.
